about: Ferro-Gradumet (ferrous sulfate 325 mg), by brand name only, is supplied eight times with directions to take one tablet twice a day, which is 650 mg of ferrous sulfate a day.

Ferro-grad (ferrous sulfate 325 mg) is supplied four times from January to April 2026, in the middle of a 14-month history, with directions to take one tablet in the morning and one at night, which is 650 mg of ferrous sulfate a day.
Ferro-Liquid (ferrous sulfate 30 mg in each mL) is supplied at 10 mL once a day, which is 300 mg of ferrous sulfate a day and below the 325 mg limit, so the criterion is not met.
